note: The few-step video arms for the meme-bot screen (#1412): FastWan2.2-TI2V-5B (3-step DMD) and Wan 2.2 T2V A14B with the lightx2v 4-step distill LoRA. Draft until one timing probe per model (dog-a, seed 1); then it is locked, and a change is a new version file. The step-1 picks and the operator's approval of the sources (2026-11-26) are on #1412.

verified_against.fastwan_dmd: vllm_omni/diffusion/models/wan2_2/pipeline_wan2_2.py:74-75 (FASTWAN_DMD_TIMESTEPS 1000, 757, 522; scheduler shift 8.0), :446 (model_index _class_name WanDMDPipeline turns on the DMD path), :1237-1240 (the request's step count is ignored: always 3 steps), :751-762 (each step predicts the clean latent and re-noises it to the next timestep), :961 (default guidance 1.0 for DMD)
verified_against.distill_lora_cli: vllm_omni/entrypoints/cli/serve.py:616-640 (--lora-path takes one file per pipeline transformer; --lora-backend distill fuses them at startup)
verified_against.distill_lora_order: vllm_omni/diffusion/lora/loader.py:442-500 (WanLoraLoaderMixin: the files match [transformer, transformer_2] by position, so high noise first, then low noise)
verified_against.distill_lora_needs_bf16: vllm_omni/diffusion/model_loader/diffusers_loader.py:569-570 and :893-898: the fuse runs after load_weights, and online FP8 quantizes inside load_weights through the layerwise loader (the comment in load_weights). FP8 fails at startup ('add_stub not implemented for Float8_e4m3fn'); INT8 can drop the LoRA on square layers with no error. vllm-project/vllm-omni#10162 (open on 2026-11-28) would refuse both. So the wan-t2v-4step server runs BF16, and generate.check_server refuses a distill LoRA with -q, --quantization or --diffusion-quantization-config.
verified_against.wan_sample_solver: vllm_omni/diffusion/models/wan2_2/pipeline_wan2_2.py:131-137 (extra_params.sample_solver picks unipc or euler), :87-100 (build_wan_scheduler); serving_video.py:500 copies extra_params into the sampling extra_args
verified_against.wan_euler_4_steps: WanEulerScheduler(shift=5.0).set_timesteps(4) gives timesteps 1000, 937.5, 833.3, 625.0 (run in the 0.32.0 venv, 2026-11-28). Unshifted, those are LightX2V's denoising_step_list 1000, 750, 500, 250. boundary_ratio 0.875 (875) sends the first two steps to the high-noise expert and the last two to the low-noise expert: LightX2V's boundary_step_index 2.

upstream.lightx2v_t2v_config: https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/blob/38d37b17e194f270a10b911c7bb403b644576ead/configs/distill/wan22/wan_moe_t2v_distill_lora.json (infer_steps 4, sample_shift 5.0, enable_cfg false, boundary_step_index 2, 81 frames at 480x832)

fastwan.note: BF16, the checkpoint's own precision: a 5B model fits one Spark without FP8. The flags otherwise follow the wan-t2v block of arms-v1.json.

wan-t2v-4step.note: BF16: no --quantization, because 0.32.0 cannot fuse a distill LoRA into FP8 weights (verified_against.distill_lora_needs_bf16). The LoRA files go high noise first, then low noise. The served name differs from the base model's, so a request for the base model never reaches the fused weights. No --boundary-ratio: the request sets it.

fastwan-t2v.sources: The FastWan model card: 3 steps, 1280x704, 121 frames, 24 fps. The server runs the three DMD timesteps whatever the request asks; num_inference_steps 3 only records it. guidance_scale 1.0 is the server's DMD default, sent so the record shows it. No negative_prompt: with guidance 1.0 there is no CFG pass to use it.

wan-t2v-4step.sources: LightX2V's wan_moe_t2v_distill_lora.json: 4 steps, sample_shift 5.0, enable_cfg false (so guidance 1.0 on both experts), boundary_step_index 2, 81 frames at 480x832. The Euler solver at shift 5.0 gives LightX2V's 4 timesteps (verified_against.wan_euler_4_steps). 16 fps: Wan 2.2 A14B's sample_fps, as in arms-v1.json. No negative_prompt: with guidance 1.0 there is no CFG pass to use it.
